****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] continue to recapture [[Russian occupation of Kharkiv Oblast|Russian-occupied territory]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]], saying that they have seized 20 more settlements in the last 24 hours, including [[Dvorichna]], and also claim to have captured many Russian [[prisoners of war]].
